DZA.note: The document names no rule or authority on AI harms; it only calls for ethical oversight.
The document names no AI system in use in administration; the zero-paper platforms are not stated to use AI.

facts.fact: El Watan reports that from the 2026 academic year the higher education ministry will deploy an intelligent assistant to personalise student paths and a large language model to assist teachers.
facts.system: assistant intelligent and LLM for teachers

facts.fact: The 5 August 2026 interministerial meeting chaired by minister Kamel Baddari set priority axes of sovereign open-source government AI models and high-performance computing in national data centres for local training by researchers and startups.
facts.system: sovereign government AI models and national data-centre computing

facts.fact: El Watan says ministerial order 1275 lets students convert their end-of-studies project into a startup or a patent.
El Watan reports 673 startups created, 3949 patents registered and 2339 'projet innovant' labels issued between 2022 and July 2026.
El Watan says the network of Maisons de l'IA serves as hubs for awareness and socio-economic partnership, with no incubation programme stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
